description: Source code for the TimeStatsHelper class in the Android SurfaceFlinger project, providing histogram management, string representations, and protobuf serialization for surface timing statistics.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::Histogram
classes.description: Manages histogram buckets for timing deltas, including insertion, total, average, and string conversion.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::JankPayload
classes.description: Represents jank frame data with a method to convert to string.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::SetFrameRateVote
classes.description: Represents a frame rate vote with a method to convert to string.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimeStatsLayer
classes.description: Contains timing and frame data for a specific layer, with methods for string conversion and protobuf serialization.

classes.name: TimeStatsHelper::TimeStatsGlobal
classes.description: Aggregates global surface timing statistics, with methods for string conversion, protobuf serialization, and generating dump stats.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a delta value into the histogram buckets.

methods.name: totalTime
methods.description: Calculates total time from histogram data.

methods.name: averageTime
methods.description: Calculates average time from histogram data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts histogram, jank payload, frame rate vote, layer, or global stats to string.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Serializes layer or global stats to protobuf message.

methods.name: generateDumpStats
methods.description: Generates a list of dump stats layers, sorted by total frames, optionally limited by maxLayers.
